checks.name: Navmesh mirrors itself

checks.hint: engine path noise: a finer bake (smaller cell / edge_max_length) or path post-processing evens it
checks.name: Unit paths (NavigationServer): pairs match their twins
checks.rule: NavigationServer3D.map_get_path length, every spot pair vs its mirrored pair: INFO > 2 % (and > 0.75 m), WARN > 5 % (and > 2 m); the polygon A* is not mirrored, so this is how much the engine's path choice (not the map) favours a side

checks.name: Keep to nearest camp / point / expansion... equal per seat
checks.rule: per kind, the seats' nearest path lengths differ <= 2 %

checks.name: Crossing widths
checks.rule: navmesh width across each crossing >= 2.0 m and equal to its twin (+-0.5 m)

checks.name: Main routes: narrowest corridor matches the twin
checks.rule: keep -> crown / enemy keep / nearest expansion: the narrowest navmesh width along the path differs from the mirrored route's by <= 1.0 m
